scope: Private durable Model download attempt ownership before host dispatch/status integration
evidence_policy: Fresh exact candidate checks and actual separate-invocation review govern component completion. These observations grant no public capability, task authority, increment or chunk pass.
controls: Reuse existing root-owned transaction/organization/receipt patterns with Model-only task, task-point, plan-point and count namespaces. No scheduler, provider, runtime, file or registry dependency is added.

Copy strict bounded passive effect/scope data before any store await; deny active/accessor/proxy/cyclic/extra input without hook execution. Normalize the exact Model request and independently recompute its manifest source digest. Bind full canonical request including request key, contract version and operation alongside immutable actor/client/host/workspace/plan/step and source digest.

Both point indexes must agree with the same immutable owner and exact record revision. Root-owned atomic reservation creates one private UUID and increments the existing per-client/workspace receipt count; acknowledged compare-and-swap issuance happens once. Unknown reserved/issued work remains unconfirmed without an accepted task ID, discovery, fresh UUID, reset or new dispatch authority.

Accepted outcomes and explicit original-call known-not-started facts retain their original attempt across newer approval revisions. The helper cannot prove physical non-execution; its eventual host must classify non-start only from the original trusted owning call, never missing status, timeout or uncertain history.

Read helpers enforce exact original actor/client/host/workspace/organization and both indexes; no Data/Context/ordinary task adoption or enumeration is provided. They are private metadata helpers: the eventual host must enforce exact current admission approval/policy/lifetime in reservation/issuance transactions. First acceptance/non-start recording uses the exact trusted original call/identity and can retain an admitted outcome after outward access ends. Publication/status separately needs current reader authority.

The existing metadata receipt ceiling and actual Model application/reconciler/source-handle boundaries remain unchanged. Metadata phases, digests and replay are not physical task status, stored bytes, registration, readiness, model quality, native cleanup/restart or parent qualification.
focused_observations: Focused scenarios cover one reservation/issuance, accepted replay, interrupted attempts, original-call non-start, atomic rollback, wrong partitions, competing reservations, lost commit replies, newer approval revisions, domain/client/host isolation, source/request/hash substitution, active/cyclic/extra input without hooks, copied data across held reads, corrupt point indexes/records, JSON owner-key order independence, unchanged count bounds and real SQLite reopen. Thirteen cases and strict scoped TypeScript passed during iteration; the final candidate adds the explicit order-independence case and receives fresh complete selected verification.

Initial focused checks exposed that generic mutation serialization omits the request key. This new Model owner now hashes its full canonical normalized request, including key/version/operation. The substitution regression verifies refusal. An initial test expected an absent result for an existing effect key with changed plan/step; it now correctly expects fail-closed denial. Changed keys cannot reserve again because the original exact plan index atomically refuses another record.

The SQLite fixture closes and reopens a real temporary database, confirms original accepted task/plan identity and source ownership, and proves reservation replay cannot start again. It closes its connection and removes only its fresh owned directory. All other fixtures are synthetic in-memory metadata; no model/provider/native runtime is invoked.

The first candidate receipt failed the added extra-field test because it expected the ledger's private error wording, while the shared passive codec correctly rejected the input with its own fixed generic error. The test now verifies rejection, no hook calls and no stored effects, without prescribing internal wording. The failed receipt is preserved. Independent review also clarified admission versus original-outcome versus reader-authority obligations in the prose; code semantics are unchanged.
qualification_limits: No Model source proposal host composition, source task execution owner, public contract/SDK/MCP/status/cancel route, scoped registry save or live transfer is enabled.

The helper does not itself establish current admission approval/liveness, original-call non-start proof or outward reader policy. Their distinct checks remain explicit obligations of the eventual trusted host composition around this metadata owner.

Actual provider/stdio/desktop/browser/model/training/generation/native/restart and final combined qualification remain separate. Accepted model-quality checks are not rerun. Parent/chunk status remains pending; primary records capacity still prevents importing isolated completion evidence without a separately reviewed storage-policy solution.
